## 1B.8 Research Note: Lula, Brazil, 2024

**Bottom line:** The 2024 record is **mostly favorable** on crisis de-escalation and channel preservation. Lula repeatedly pushed dialogue, ceasefire, and anti-nuclear language in high-tension moments involving Ukraine and Gaza. The main caution is that his Gaza rhetoric was highly confrontational, and the Brazil-China Ukraine initiative was later criticized by Kyiv as exclusionary.

### Accepted claims

- **Claim:** In February 2024, Lula explicitly framed his talks with the U.S. as peace-oriented and reiterated an end-to-war message on Ukraine and Gaza.
  - **Title:** [Lula said he discussed peace in Ukraine and Gaza with Antony Blinken](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/21/lula-diz-que-discutiu-conflitos-em-gaza-e-na-ucrania-em-encontro-com-blinken.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** February 21, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/21/lula-diz-que-discutiu-conflitos-em-gaza-e-na-ucrania-em-encontro-com-blinken.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula said he discussed peace in Ukraine and Gaza with Antony Blinken, and Planalto separately reiterated his desire for peace and an end to the conflicts. This is strong evidence of clear communication and de-escalatory intent in a crisis setting.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.8`; also `1B.1`, `1B.4`

- **Claim:** In May 2024, Brazil and China issued a Ukraine peace proposal centered on talks and a ceasefire.
  - **Title:** [Brazil and China sign joint proposal for peace negotiation in the Russia-Ukraine war](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/05/23/brasil-e-china-assinam-proposta-conjunta-de-negociacao-de-paz-para-guerra-da-ucrania-e-russia.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** May 23, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/05/23/brasil-e-china-assinam-proposta-conjunta-de-negociacao-de-paz-para-guerra-da-ucrania-e-russia.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** The joint statement said dialogue and negotiation were the only viable solution and called for conditions to resume direct talks and move toward a comprehensive ceasefire. This is direct evidence that Lula preserved crisis channels aimed at lowering the chance of accidental escalation.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.8`; also `1B.1`, `1B.4`

- **Claim:** At the UN General Assembly in September 2024, Lula warned against nuclear confrontation and insisted on direct dialogue.
  - **Title:** [Speech by President Lula at the opening of the 79th UN General Assembly in New York](https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
  - **Date:** September 24, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula said military spending and nuclear arsenals were rising, described destructive weapons as pushing the world toward Cold War-style confrontation, and argued that direct dialogue was crucial. This is strong evidence of clear, crisis-aware de-escalation messaging.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.8`; also `1B.1`, `1B.2`, `1B.4`

- **Claim:** At the Summit of the Future in September 2024, Lula explicitly rejected a return to “living with nuclear threats.”
  - **Title:** [President Lula's speech at the Summit of the Future opening in New York](https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/president-lulas-speech-at-the-summit-of-the-future-opening-in-new-york)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
  - **Date:** September 22, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/president-lulas-speech-at-the-summit-of-the-future-opening-in-new-york
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula said the world “cannot go back to living with nuclear threats” and linked that warning to arms-race criticism and multilateral reform. This is direct evidence of crisis communication aimed at reducing accidental-war risk.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.8`; also `1B.2`, `1B.4`

- **Claim:** Lula’s 2024 Gaza rhetoric was confrontational enough to trigger a diplomatic rupture, which is the main counterexample to a clean de-escalation record.
  - **Title:** [Lula repeats that the Israeli government commits genocide in Gaza and defends the creation of a Palestinian state](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** February 23, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula repeated the genocide accusation and defended Palestinian statehood, and the report says this caused a major diplomatic rupture with Israel. This is not nuclear brinkmanship, but it is crisis rhetoric that increased tension rather than smoothing it.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.8`; also `1B.2`

- **Claim:** The Brazil-China Ukraine initiative was criticized by Ukraine as excluding Kyiv and being “destructive,” which weakens the channel-preservation case.
  - **Title:** [Ukraine's Zelenskiy dismisses 'destructive' China-Brazil peace initiative](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/ukraines-zelenskiy-dismisses-destructive-chinabrazil-peace-initiative-3612966)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via Investing.com
  - **Date:** September 12, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/ukraines-zelenskiy-dismisses-destructive-chinabrazil-peace-initiative-3612966
  - **Claim-level summary:** Zelenskiy said the initiative was destructive, complained Kyiv was not included, and argued it lacked respect for Ukraine’s territorial integrity. That does not prove bad faith, but it is real counterevidence against a fully effective crisis-channel strategy.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.8`; also `1B.4`

### Search gap

I did **not** find evidence that Lula:
- issued reckless nuclear threats during crises,
- cut off diplomatic channels,
- or escalated toward accidental war.

The clearest 2024 pattern is the opposite: repeated calls for dialogue, ceasefire, and anti-nuclear restraint. The main limitations are that some rhetoric, especially on Gaza, was sharply escalatory, and one peace initiative was criticized as insufficiently inclusive.
